records.reason: The app never gates a specific familiar behind its requiredCount — CompanionsTab shows '(N min)' as reference text only and the specific-familiar picker is ungated — so lowering the requirement by two changes nothing the app enforces.
Same as Improved Familiar: requiredCount on a specific familiar is display-only in CompanionsTab and never enforced, so the -2 requirement has nothing to relax.
Only changes how long a TARGET undead stays your minion after its save; nothing on your own sheet changes.
Extends the forced movement of a Shove and adds damage to the target/obstacle — resolved at the table on the target's side.
Raises the damage a simple poison deals to the TARGET and saves the dose on a crit fail; no statistic of yours changes.
Extends your Shield Block's damage reduction to adjacent ALLIES; it changes their damage taken, not your sheet.
Treating the weapon as dawnsilver/duskwood/peachwood matters only for overcoming a TARGET's resistances; it grants no bonus or statistic on your sheet.
Changes how the Swift Banishment reaction is fuelled (sacrifice any 5th+ slot) and imposes a penalty on the TARGET's save; the slot spend and the spell are resolved at the table.
Grants an extra reaction usable only for Twin Riposte and drops the Twin Parry requirement — action economy resolved in play.

Removes the -2 item penalty to attack rolls with improvised and shoddy weapons — a player-side attack-roll effect. The situational lane already carries exactly this wording for resurgent-maelstrom (src/rules/situationalBonuses.ts), and this feat carries nothing.

situational.when: with an improvised or a shoddy weapon
situational.bonus: the -2 item penalty does not apply

records.reason: critSpecWeapons can only name real weapon ids/groups/traits and core.json contains no improvised weapon items to attach brawling crit spec to; the GM may also substitute another group, so any grant would be an assertion the data can't carry.
A downtime/exploration Crafting permission — the app tracks neither known formulas nor a repair kit, so Repairing and Crafting basic gear is table adjudication.
Lets you Repair without a repair kit or a stable surface at a time cost; the app models neither repair kits nor Repair time.
A 3-action activity that patches a broken item into a shoddy one at the table; item broken/shoddy state and activations are resolved in play.
A skill substitution (Deception for Stealth) inside the Avoid Notice exploration activity — the app has no skill-substitution lane and its peers (Versatile Performance) are inert for the same reason.
Changes what happens to creatures that fail against your horde's Mobbing Assault (grabbed/restrained, extra damage) — entirely target-side.
A spellshape that relocates a composition's emanation to an ALLY; it changes the spell's origin at cast time, not your sheet.
Each mature Beastmaster companion advances to nimble or savage — the maturity ladder the engine models. No COMPANION_MODS entry exists, so the upgrade never reaches the companion block.

companionMod.note: Incredible Beastmaster Companion: each of your mature Beastmaster companions is at least a nimble or savage animal companion (your choice per companion) — pick savage in Edit for any companion you want on that side. Any companion that becomes mature later also gains this.

records.reason: 'It becomes either a nimble or savage animal companion' is the engine's maturity ladder, but the feat has no COMPANION_MODS entry, so the companion block never advances.

companionMod.note: Incredible Companion: your animal companion is at least a nimble or savage companion (your choice) — pick savage in Edit if you want that side.

companionMod.note: Incredible Construct Companion: your construct companion is at least an incredible construct companion — the nimble/savage rung here; pick savage in Edit if that fits your build better.

companionMod.note: Incredible Dragon Companion: your dragon companion is at least a nimble or savage animal companion (your choice) — pick savage in Edit if you want that side.

companionGrant.label: Incredible Familiar
companionGrant.note: Grants a familiar you configure here. Choose 6 familiar or master abilities each day.

records.reason: The invested-item cap is hard-coded at 10 in src/sheet/InventoryTab.tsx (INVESTED_LIMIT, enforced on the Invest button, on drag-to-invest and in the x/10 badge), so a character with this feat literally cannot invest their 11th and 12th item. No legal field raises the cap.
The Cavalier mount advances to nimble or savage — the maturity ladder — and no COMPANION_MODS entry exists for the feat.

companionMod.note: Incredible Mount: the mount you gained from Cavalier Dedication is at least a nimble or savage animal companion (your choice) — pick savage in Edit if you want that side.

records.reason: 'It becomes an incredible construct companion' is the nimble/savage rung (matching advanced-reanimated-companion's mature entry one rung below), and nothing registers this feat.

companionMod.note: Incredible Reanimated Companion: your reanimated construct companion is at least an incredible construct companion — the nimble/savage rung here; pick savage in Edit if that fits your build better.

records.reason: A 1-action activity that fires up to five Recall Knowledge checks; the checks and their results are resolved at the table.
Grants a Strike that ignores the target's concealment and cover — an action whose benefit is entirely about the target's defences.
A 2-action activity to Stride three times; it grants no Speed bonus, only action economy.

An amp applied when you cast a psi cantrip — the resistance may land on a target instead of you and lasts to the start of your next turn, so it is a spell effect at cast time rather than a standing sheet statistic (none of the 8 amp records carry mechanics).
Imposes checks on a creature YOU have grabbed when it teleports or Escapes — entirely target-side.
Grants an extra reaction each enemy turn usable only for Opportune Riposte/Reactive Strike — action economy resolved in play.
Extends your Catharsis activation benefits to one ALLY; it changes the ally's statistics, not yours.
A 2-action Strike activity that inflicts stupefied and blocks reactions on the target; no player statistic changes.
A 2-action Strike activity (melee gauntlet-bow Strike, grab, then a ranged Strike) resolved at the table.
A 1-action activity that combines a reload with Hide/Sneak/Take Cover; pure action compression, no statistic changes.

The immanence deals spirit damage to enemies ADJACENT to the target and the transcendence is a 3-action activity — no bonus or statistic on your own sheet (unlike the ikons that do give one, which carry situational entries).
A 3-action impulse that creates an illusion and imposes saves and conditions on creatures in the area — entirely target-side.

A daily-preparation flexibility (leave a slot undecided, later cast any spellbook spell two ranks lower). The app's prep is manual — the player can already put the lower-rank spell in a slot — and no prep-flexibility lane exists; the deferred decision is table bookkeeping.
A skill substitution (Performance in place of Diplomacy to Request) after a successful Make an Impression; the app has no skill-substitution lane and this changes no statistic.

Spending a Living History use gives YOU extra spirit damage on every weapon and unarmed attack until the end of your next turn — a toggleable self-buff with a duration, which is the mode lane (note-only, as scouring-spark already does for an extra-damage rider). The feat carries nothing.

mode.name: Infused with Belkzen's Might
mode.duration: until the end of your next turn
mode.note: Infused with Belkzen's Might: expend one use of your storied skin's Living History. Your weapon and unarmed Strikes deal additional spirit damage equal to 1 plus half the number of Tattooed Historian feats you have (so 1 with one or two such feats, 2 with three or four, and so on).

records.reason: A 1-action set-up that enlarges the next Dragonet Breath's area and adds a damage die to it — it modifies an area effect against targets, resolved when the breath is used.

The app never withholds an eidolon type's initial ability from an archetype eidolon — the eidolon block is built from the chosen type (deriveEidolon's TYPE_PACKAGE plus the subclass option's text) with no gate — so this feat lifts a restriction the app does not impose.
Extends how long you can hold your breath; the app tracks no breath/suffocation clock.
Permits Sailing Lore (a prerequisite, not a grant) for Recall Knowledge on certain subjects and adds a secret GM check; no statistic or proficiency changes.
A 1-action rage activity that reduces your own enfeebled value by 1 in play; conditions are edited on the sheet by the player as they change.
Accelerates disease stage reduction on successful Fortitude saves; the app tracks no ongoing disease stages, and this is no bonus to the save itself.

Adds shapes to the Untamed Form list and extends a polymorph duration; the app models neither the Untamed Form shape list nor spell durations (its peers Ferocious/Soaring/Dragon Shape carry nothing either).
A degree-of-success shift on Command an Animal checks, rolled at the table; no bonus or statistic changes.
Delivered: the core.json record carries refocusRestore, the field the engine reads to refill the whole focus pool on Refocus.
Waives the requirement to prepare before using the Aid reaction after a critical success; Aid and its preparation are resolved at the table.
A ritual plus a 3-action activity that stows and re-dons your heavy armor; donning time is not modelled and the armor's own statistics are unchanged.
A reaction to drop a misfired firearm and draw another weapon — an Interact resolved at the table.
A single action producing a temporary forged document (a Forgery item created and dismissed in play); no statistic changes.
A 1-action distraction that makes a TARGET off-guard against your attacks.
A reaction that loads the enemy's ammunition and Strikes back; the ammunition's special effects apply to the target at the table.

Gives an archetype barbarian the instinct ability of the instinct chosen at Barbarian Dedication (Draconic Rage's damage, Animal Instinct's unarmed Strike, Giant Instinct's larger weapon, and so on). Barbarian Dedication records the pick in the `barbarianInstinct` choice flag, but nothing in src/ ever reads it — rageStrikeRider in src/rules/derive.ts only honours subclassId for a real barbarian and hands an archetype a flat 2 damage — so the feat delivers nothing and no legal field can express instinct abilities.
A triggered free action that gives your animal companion its actions and forces one to be Support — companion action economy resolved in play.
Grants an extra reaction each turn usable only to Interrupt Charge — action economy resolved in play.
